main_text.p: aliis civiliter; in priori membro prorsus cum jure Canonico conveniunt, casus enim illos tantum complectuntur, qui-bus Clericus aut ante aut post trinam monitionem per Canones & Pontific. decreta omni privilegio Clericali ipso facto excidit.

Secundi membri casus vocant privilegiatos, ideo ab annis 250. paulo plus minusve celebris in foro fuit criminis, quod ad Clericos attinet, di-stinctio in privilegiatum & commune; privilegiatum dicebatur illud, cujus co-gnitionem sibi vendicare poterant Judi-ces Laici, quod privilegiatum dicebant, eo quod jus illud cognitionis Pontificis privilegio se habere jactabant; in illud autem animadvertebant civiliter tan-tùm, nunquam criminaliter, hoc est propter crimen illud commissum Cleri-cus multa pecuniaria tantum punieba-tur, cogebaturque in carceribus [illegible, ~3 letters]isco-palibus subsistere, donec satisfecisset[?], sed in ipsius personam aliquid attentare ne-fas ducebant; antiquiores pragmatici duos tantùm ejusmodi enumerant, quos bar-

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page and is kept as printed. A black ink blot covers the start of "Episcopalibus" (line 21), so the first letters are illegible. "satisfecisset" is read from a worn long-s form and marked [?]. The word "bar-" at the end is a line-end hyphen; the rest of the word continues on the next page. No catchword is printed below the text.
